subject: NEET PG Strategy
title: NEET PG: A Practical Timed Mock Strategy
preview: Use targeted mock analysis, error review and pacing rather than relying on a fixed exam-year template.

sections.title: Plan the pass sequence
points: Answer confidently recognized items efficiently, flag uncertain ones and return according to the permitted exam interface.
A pacing strategy should reflect the actual pattern, on-screen navigation rules and your own performance data.

sections.title: Optimize learning from mocks
points: Use question review to identify recurring clinical reasoning failures and fix them with focused revision.
Check whether speed improvements are accompanied by stable or better accuracy.

sections.title: Exam trap
points: Do not assume a past examination format or session duration remains unchanged.
Blind elimination is not a substitute for recognizing pathophysiology and red flags.

quickRevision: Read the current official exam information bulletin for the specific session before choosing a timing strategy.
Practice finishing sections with enough time reserved for flagged questions and review.
Track wrong answers by knowledge gap, interpretation error and time pressure.

quiz.question: What should guide a mock-test answering strategy?
options: Accuracy, time discipline and review of weak patterns
Always spending equal time on every item
quiz.explanation: Accuracy, time discipline and review of weak patterns. Use question review to identify recurring clinical reasoning failures and fix them with focused revision.
